# Known error-severity shellcheck findings, as "<path> <SC-code>".
#
# CI fails on any error-level finding NOT listed here. Removing a line is always safe; adding one
# should be a deliberate decision with the reason written next to it.
#
# Both entries below are SC1087 ("use braces when expanding arrays") on a variable followed by a
# LITERAL square bracket -- a grep regex character class in one case, a Klipper section name in the
# other. Bash does not treat "$var[...]" as an array subscript (that needs "${var[...]}"), so both
# lines do exactly what they read as. They are listed rather than rewritten because these scripts are
# hardware-tested and the change would be cosmetic.
unleashed-x-kaos/scripts/kaos-home-hook.sh SC1087
unleashed-x-kaos/scripts/kaos-sideload.sh SC1087
